## Purpose 
make a release

## To-do

## Content

### Re-add update_biomass! as a deprecated method

This is to avoid making a breaking change, which would make
the next release need to be v2.0.0 . 

The change could
still be considered breaking if someone is extending
`update_biomass!` and expects it to be called during the cache update.
I modified the NEWS entry to mention that.

Bumps minor version and updates manifests
